description: This Java source file defines the ShopOrder class, representing an order entity in an e-commerce system. It extends PersistableOrder and includes properties such as shopping cart items, order total summary, shipping details, payment method, and error messages.

classes.name: ShopOrder
classes.description: Represents a customer's order with related shopping cart items, shipping, payment, and total summary details.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items associated with this order.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shopping cart items associated with this order.

methods.name: setOrderTotalSummary
methods.description: Sets the summary of the total order amounts.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves error message associated with the order, if any.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets an error message for the order.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodType
methods.description: Gets the payment method type chosen by the user.
